13: combatRouter.post('/start', wrap<{ campaignId: string }>(async (req, res) => {
14:   const campaign = await getCampaign(req.params.campaignId);
15:   if (!campaign) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'No such campaign.' }); return; }

21:   } catch (err) {
22:     if (err instanceof CampaignArchivedError) { res.status(409).json({ error: err.message }); return; }
23:     if (err instanceof PlayingRequiredError) { res.status(409).json({ error: err.message }); return; }
24:     throw err;
25:   }
26: 
27:   const existing = await getActiveEncounter(campaign.Id);
28:   if (existing) { res.status(409).json({ error: 'An Encounter is already active.' }); return; }
29: 
30:   // V0.5 Combat Loop step 1's Rapport modifier (slice 5) — confirms and completes what open
31:   // issue 13 had only surfaced: initiating grants +1 (+2 if all Heroes share the fight's goal);
32:   // not initiating grants -1 only if the party is also ill-prepared or off-balance; otherwise no
33:   // change. The GM answers these three questions on the start form. Landing the Rapport write in
34:   // the same request as the Encounter (rather than two separate client calls) means a failure on
35:   // either side can't leave one half done and not the other.
36:   const initiatedByHeroes = !!req.body?.initiatedByHeroes;
37:   const sharedGoal = !!req.body?.sharedGoal;
38:   const illPreparedOrOffBalance = !!req.body?.illPreparedOrOffBalance;
39:   const rapportDelta = combatStartRapportDelta({ initiatedByHeroes, sharedGoal, illPreparedOrOffBalance });
40:   const rapportNote =
41:     rapportDelta > 0 ? `${rapportDelta > 1 ? '+2' : '+1'} Rapport` : rapportDelta < 0 ? '-1 Rapport' : 'no Rapport change';
42: 
43:   const encounter: Encounter = {
44:     Id: newId('enc'),
45:     CampaignId: campaign.Id,
46:     Status: 'Active',
47:     CombatGoal: String(req.body?.combatGoal ?? '').trim(),
48:     CombatGoalAchieved: false,
49:     DefiantGoals: [],
50:     Round: 1,
51:     ActingSide: null,
52:     ActingParticipantId: null,
53:     PairedParticipantId: null,
54:     FirstSide: null,

59:     UpdatedAt: nowIso(),

61:   await saveEncounter(encounter);
62: 
63:   if (rapportDelta !== 0) {
64:     const party = await getParty(campaign.Id);
65:     if (party) {

67:       // banked until the next Make Camp rather than lost (see logic.ts's
68:       // applyPartyRapportAdvance/spendRapportForAid doc comments for the full mechanic).
69:       party.Rapport = Math.max(0, party.Rapport + rapportDelta);
70:       await saveParty(party);

74:   res.status(201).json({ encounter });

All 21 tests pass. Here's a summary of what was changed:

**`apps/server/src/routes/combat.ts`:**
- Added `getSheet` and `saveSheet` to the repo imports
- After finding the existing Encounter but before saving, added a loop over `existing.Participants` that:
  - Skips non-PC participants (Enemies)
  - Loads each Hero's sheet via `getSheet(participant.RefId)`, skipping nulls
  - Only calls `saveSheet` for sheets with at least one marked Strain box
- Prepend a `{ Id, At, Text: 'Combat ended.' }` History entry at the front
- The response is still 200 with `{ encounter }` showing `Status: 'Ended'`

**`apps/server/src/routes/combat.test.ts`:**
- Added `getSheet` and `saveSheet` to the repo mock
- 3 new tests in the `/end` describe block, each covering a requirement:
  - `"clears Strain on all PC Heroes and adds a history entry"` — verifies Strain cleared + saved, null Strain not saved, Enemies skipped, History prepended
  - `"refuses a non-GM and reads/writes no sheets"` — verifies 403 before any sheet access
  - `"skips null sheets without crashing"` — verifies graceful handling

If the combat.ts fix is reverted, the Strain-clearing test will fail because `getSheet` and `saveSheet` won't be called.
